ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones occupying the central area of each lobe, bisected by a low-intensity black vertical band at the median notch. Low-intensity black borders delineate the entire trailing and outer edge, with secondary low-intensity mottling and focal spots concentrated near the notch and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Significant pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) observed along the continuous boundary, particularly prominent on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe and within the medial notch region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve extending from the central notch to the acute distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel points distributed across the high-intensity white surfaces, primarily in the lower-central region of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Detection of textured, low-intensity dark masses (barnacles) on the outer distal tip of the left lobe and the trailing edge of the right lobe. Irregular indentation/loss of tissue on the upper left lobe tip.
